prompt.en: How do First Nations, Métis and Inuit people make their views heard with federal, provincial and territorial governments?
prompt.fr: Comment les Premières Nations, les Métis et les Inuits font-ils entendre leur point de vue auprès des gouvernements fédéral, provinciaux et territoriaux?

options.en: Through one single national body that speaks for everyone.
options.fr: Par un seul organisme national qui parle au nom de tous.

options.en: Through a number of provincial, regional and national organizations.
options.fr: Par plusieurs organisations provinciales, régionales et nationales.

options.en: Only through their members of Parliament.
options.fr: Uniquement par l'entremise de leurs députés fédéraux.

options.en: They have no organizations of their own.
options.fr: Ils n'ont pas d'organisations qui leur soient propres.

explanation.en: There is no single voice. Many organizations work at the provincial, regional and national level, and they deal with all three levels of government.
explanation.fr: Il n'y a pas une voix unique. De nombreuses organisations travaillent aux échelles provinciale, régionale et nationale, et elles traitent avec les trois ordres de gouvernement.

source.quote: There are a number of provincial, regional and national Aboriginal organizations that are a voice for First Nations, Métis and Inuit people in their relationships with the federal, provincial and territorial governments.

verification.evidence: The First Nations have band chiefs and councillors who have major responsibilities on First Nations reserves, including housing, schools and other services. There are a number of provincial, regional and national Aboriginal organizations that are a voice for First Nations, Métis and Inuit people in their relationships with the federal, provincial and territorial governments.
